assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The service is medically necessary to evaluate underlying arrhythmias
The service is medically necessary to evaluate hemodynamic instability
The member has recurrent episodes of syncope
The member has transient neurological deficits
The neurological deficits are suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service is appropriate for identifying potential causes of the syncopal events
The syncopal events result in cerebral hypoperfusion
The service addresses hemodynamic instability contributing to both syncope and transient cerebral ischemic events
